import json
from pathlib import Path
from nabt.arabic_reader import read_arabic
from nabt.discourse_laws import connective_value, coordination_projection, causal_allowed
from nabt.corpus_evidence import learn_qac_lexicon
from nabt.discourse import read_discourse, ask_discourse, verify_discourse
for text in ('زيدٌ هو قائمٌ و جالسٌ.', 'زيد عالم أو هند كاتب.', 'إذا ?س هو باحث فإن ?س هو مدقق.', 'ليت زيدا قائم.'):
    r=read_arabic(text)
    print(json.dumps({'layer':'arabic_reader','text':text,'accepted':r.accepted,'facts':len(r.document.facts),'rules':len(r.document.rules),'forms':[s.form for s in r.steps],'obligations':[list(s.obligations) for s in r.steps]},ensure_ascii=False))
print(json.dumps({'layer':'discourse_laws','truth':{op:[connective_value(op,a,b) for a,b in ((False,False),(False,True),(True,False),(True,True))] for op in ('AND','OR','XOR','IMPLIES')},'positive_branch_projection':{op:coordination_projection(op,'positive') for op in ('AND','OR','XOR','IMPLIES')},'causal_without_relation':causal_allowed(relation_licensed=False, source_supported=True, scope_complete=True,endpoints_resolved=True)},ensure_ascii=False))
model=learn_qac_lexicon(Path('examples/discourse_training.tsv').read_bytes())
context=json.loads(Path('examples/discourse_context.json').read_text())
for text in ('زيد عالم و هند كاتب.', 'إنَّ هذا عالم.', 'إن هذا عالم.', 'زيد عالم. هو كاتب.', 'ليت هذا عالم.', 'هذان', 'ضَرَبَنِي زَيْدٌ.'):
    r=read_discourse(text,lexical_model=model,context=context)
    claims=[{k:c[k] for k in ('predicate','args','positive','tense')} for c in r['claims']]
    print(json.dumps({'layer':'discourse_reader','text':text,'status':r['status'],'claims':claims,'replay_valid':verify_discourse(r,lexical_model=model,context=context)['valid']},ensure_ascii=False))
